author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at Reddit once again and find after a massive controversy hits r/livestreamfails, one of their head mods has been deposed by the side. This moderator does not take losing his power kindly and has instead issued a statement against the CEO, all at the expense of whatever dignity they had left. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: We Found Reddit's Smelliest Moderator...
